description: This file defines internal kernel memory management APIs, macros for address translation, and functions for mapping and unmapping physical memory regions in the Zephyr RTOS kernel.

methods.name: z_mem_phys_addr
methods.description: Converts a virtual address to a physical address with type safety and assertions.

methods.name: z_mem_virt_addr
methods.description: Converts a physical address to a virtual address with type safety and assertions.

methods.name: z_phys_map
methods.description: Maps a physical memory region into the kernel's virtual address space.

methods.name: z_phys_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps a virtual memory region from the kernel's virtual address space.
